definition.simple: The cash left after the business pays to keep itself running and growing.
definition.balanced: Free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditure (money spent on equipment, buildings, software). It is the cash available to pay debt, pay [[dividend|dividends]], or save. Negative free cash flow is normal for some growing firms, but it has to be funded by cash, borrowing or new shares.

example: Operating cash flow 150, capital expenditure 32: free cash flow = 118 (fictional, millions USD).
